title: Fuzzy Dark Matter as a diffractive barrier: Wave-optics Signatures of Ultralight Fields on Lensed Gravitational Waves
summary: Gravitational waves (GWs) propagate through the universe from sources at high redshift, experiencing the gravitational fields of the intervening matter distribution. Halos composed of ultralight dark matter (ULDM) contain strong density fluctuations, reflecting the interference pattern in the field distribution of the ultralight bosons. In the wave-optics regime, ULDM fluctuations act as a diffractive grating, imprinting frequency-dependent modulations of GWs, in addition to magnification and other gravitational lensing effects. Since lensing depends on the projected surface density, we derive its approximate probability distribution and show how it departs from a Gaussian distribution depending on the halo profile and coherence length. We then quantify how the GW diffraction signatures produced by the granules depend on macroimage magnification and parity. The ULDM interference network imprints stochastic diffraction fluctuations at the $O(1)\%$ level on GWs moderately lensed by the host when the Fresnel scale is comparable to the granule coherence length $r_F(f)\sim\ell_c$. These fluctuations can be enhanced to $\gtrsim10\%$ when the host macroimage forms near the critical curve or for Type II macroimages. For massive black hole binaries observed by LISA, the diffraction signature can be detectable around the ULDM particle mass $m_φ\sim10^{-21}$ eV, providing either a smoking-gun signature of ULDM or new constraints on $m_φ$.

AI.tldr: 超轻暗物质（ULDM）晕的干涉图样在波光学区域充当衍射光栅，对引力波（GW）产生随频率变化的调制，本文推导了透镜面密度分布的近似概率分布（偏离高斯）并量化了衍射特征对宏观像放大率与宇称的依赖，指出在宿主晕中等透镜下可留下 O(1)% 的随机衍射涨落，临界曲线附近或Type II像可达 ≳10%，LISA 对 \(m_\phi\sim10^{-21}\) eV 可探测。
AI.motivation: GW 从高红移源传播时会穿过前景物质引力场；若暗物质为超轻玻色子，其晕内存在强密度涨落（场的干涉图样），在波光学区域应表现为对 GW 的额外频率依赖调制。作者希望厘清这些衍射签名的大小、统计性质及其对透镜构型的依赖，并评估其可探测性。
AI.method: 解析与半解析建模：将 ULDM 涨落视为衍射光栅，在波光学框架下处理 GW 传播；基于投影面密度导出透镜（放大率等）的近似概率分布，并考察其相对高斯的偏离如何随晕剖面与相干长度变化；进而分析衍射信号对宏观像放大率与宇称（Type I/II）的依赖，比较菲涅耳尺度 \(r_F(f)\) 与颗粒相干长度 \(\ell_c\)。
AI.result: 透镜分布总体偏离高斯，偏离程度由晕剖面与相干长度决定；当 \(r_F(f)\sim\ell_c\) 且宿主晕形成中等透镜时，ULDM 干涉网络在 GW 上留下 O(1)% 量级的随机衍射涨落；若宏观像靠近临界曲线或为 Type II 像，涨落可增强至 ≳10%；对 LISA 观测的大质量黑洞双星，该签名在 \(m_\phi\sim10^{-21}\) eV 附近可探测。
AI.conclusion: ULDM 颗粒的衍射效应对引力波提供了独特的、频率依赖的观测量：既可成为超轻暗物质的“确凿证据”（smoking gun），也可为粒子质量 \(m_\phi\) 提供新的限制，尤其借助 LISA 对高红移大质量黑洞双星的观测。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 引力波（GWs）从高红移源在宇宙中传播，经历中间物质分布的引力场。由超轻暗物质（ULDM）组成的晕包含强密度涨落，反映了超轻玻色子场分布中的干涉图案。在波动光学区域，ULDM涨落充当衍射光栅，除了放大和其他引力透镜效应外，还对GWs施加频率依赖的调制。由于透镜效应取决于投影表面密度，我们推导了其近似概率分布，并展示了它如何根据晕轮廓和相干长度偏离高斯分布。然后我们量化了颗粒产生的GW衍射特征如何依赖于宏观像放大率和宇称。当菲涅尔尺度与颗粒相干长度相当（$r_F(f)\sim\ell_c$）时，ULDM干涉网络在宿主中等透镜化的GWs上印下$O(1)\%$水平的随机衍射涨落。当宿主宏观像形成于临界曲线附近或对于Type II宏观像时，这些涨落可以增强到$\gtrsim10\%$。对于LISA观测到的 massive black hole binaries，衍射特征在ULDM粒子质量$m_φ\sim10^{-21}$ eV附近可探测，提供ULDM的确凿证据或对$m_φ$的新限制。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要：ULDM颗粒的衍射效应对引力波提供了独特的、频率依赖的观测量：既可成为超轻暗物质的“确凿证据”（smoking gun），也可为粒子质量 \(m_\phi\) 提供新的限制，尤其借助LISA对高红移大质量黑洞双星的观测。

Lengths and wave numbers are expressed in units of \(\ell_{c}\) and \(\ell_{c}^{-1}\) , respectively. A : granule potential \(\psi\) over the periodic box, with the Fresnel zones \(w\,\Delta\phi_{0}=n\pi\) of the macroimage (cross) at \(w=1\) , elliptic for the minimum (solid) and hyperbolic for the saddle (dashed). B : spectrum \(|\hat{g}_{w}(\bm{k})|\) of the phase screen, Eq. ( 39 ), non-zero only on the lattice \(\bm{k}\in(2\pi/L)\,\mathbb{Z}^{2}\) of the periodic box, with the transfer-function phases \(Q_{\bm{k}}/2w=n\pi\) of Eq. ( 37 ). C : the \(\bm{k}\) integral in Eq. ( 40 ) restricted to the disk \(|\bm{k}|\leq K\) , \(S_{K}\) , at \(w=1\) . For the phase, we remove the geometric image arrival time shift of the combined host and granule lens relative to the smooth host. At Born order, this removes the phase contribution \(-w\psi(\bm{x}^{*})\) , where \(\bm{x}^{*}\) is the unperturbed macroimage position.

title: Deconstructing the cosmic baryon distribution with fast radio bursts
summary: The precise distribution of baryons in the Universe remains an open question in cosmology, as their highly diffuse nature hinders direct observation. However, mapping it is integral for precision cosmology in studies of gravitational lensing, galaxy evolution and the cosmic microwave background with current and upcoming surveys. We use fast radio bursts (FRBs) and their dispersion measures (DMs) to probe and localise this baryon distribution in the large-scale structure (LSS). Using IllustrisTNG simulations, we classify the LSS into eight bins of increasing matter density, analogous to voids, filaments, and haloes. We model the DM contribution from each substructure and compare it with the simulated DMs to infer the density estimator, the ratio of electron number to total matter density. The resulting overdetermined system is solved in a Bayesian framework with a simulation-physics-informed model. To demonstrate observational applicability, we create a Euclid-like mock galaxy catalogue and build a density estimator based on luminous matter along FRB sightlines. We apply a bias correction for the underlying dark matter distribution and compare the two density estimators to recover the electron number density across the eight bins. Electrons are predominantly localised in low-density regions, while the ensemble mean across all bins aligns with the global theoretical estimate. Combining the FRB and galaxy density estimators, we recover the density of ionised baryons as $Ω_b f_{ion} = 0.0455^{+0.0028}_{-0.0026}$ (simulation: 0.0462), corresponding to $Ω_b = 0.0479^{+0.0029}_{-0.0027}$ for $f_{ion}=0.95$. Our bin-wise electron density estimate reproduces the simulation ground truth to within 10 per cent and gives gas fractions of $0.186 \pm 0.012$, $0.179 \pm 0.015$ and $0.046 \pm 0.014$ in voids, filaments and haloes, against ground truths of 0.167, 0.173 and 0.067.

title: The GECKOS Survey: deriving bar properties in edge-on galaxies from molecular gas kinematics
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures (+4 appendix pages and 7 appendix figures). Submitted to A&A
summary: The characterisation of disc-connected structures such as bars and nuclear rings is a difficult task in edge-on galaxies. We present a simple method to derive bar position angles and lengths in edge-on galaxies using molecular gas kinematics from ALMA observations. Our approach exploits the geometry of bar-driven gas flows: assuming that cold molecular gas settles into an elliptical nuclear ring oriented orthogonally to the bar, the line-of-sight velocity of the nuclear ring varies predictably with bar viewing angle. Using only the observed nuclear ring velocity and a circular velocity derived from Multi-Gaussian Expansion (MGE) stellar mass models, we construct a grid of bisymmetric bar flow models spanning a range of radial and transverse velocities to constrain the bar position angle. We validate this methodology on a toy model and an isolated galaxy hydrodynamical simulation snapshot, demonstrating that the technique reliably distinguishes three viewing angle brackets: side-on (0° - 35°), intermediate (35° - 65°), and end-on (65° - 90°). Applying this method to six GECKOS Survey galaxies hosting boxy-peanut bulges with ALMA CO observations, we find four bars oriented side-on, one at an intermediate angle, and one end-on case (IC 1711), the latter confirming predictions from stellar kinematics alone. Derived nuclear ring sizes and deprojected bar lengths are broadly consistent with measurements from more face-on literature samples. This method offers a practical and computationally inexpensive means of constraining bar properties in edge-on galaxies, complementing full dynamical modelling approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用ALMA分子气体运动学在侧向星系中测量棒旋结构位置角和长度的方法，基于冷分子气体形成与棒正交的椭圆核环这一几何假设，通过构建双对称棒流模型网格来约束棒的视角，并在模拟与6个GECKOS星系样本上验证。
AI.motivation: 侧向星系（edge-on galaxies）中的盘连通结构（如棒和核环）难以表征，缺乏简单有效的测量手段；现有方法多为完整的动力学建模，计算代价高，需要一种实用且低成本的替代方案。
AI.method: 假设冷分子气体沉降为与棒正交的椭圆核环，其视向速度随棒视角可预测地变化。仅使用观测到的核环速度和由多高斯展开（MGE）恒星质量模型导出的圆速度，构建覆盖径向与横向速度范围的双对称棒流模型网格，据此约束棒的位置角。方法在玩具模型和孤立星系流体动力学模拟快照上验证，随后应用于6个含盒状-花生状核球的GECKOS巡天星系（有ALMA CO观测）。
AI.result: 验证显示该方法能可靠区分三个视角区间：侧向（0°–35°）、中等（35°–65°）和端向（65°–90°）。在6个GECKOS星系中，4个棒为侧向取向，1个为中等角度，1个为端向（IC 1711），后者证实了仅凭恒星运动学的预测。导出的核环尺寸和去投影棒长与更正面取向文献样本的测量大致一致。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为侧向星系中约束棒性质提供了一种实用且计算廉价的手段，可补充完整动力学建模方法。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 在侧向星系中，刻画棒和核环等与盘相连的结构是一项困难的任务。我们提出了一种简单的方法，利用 ALMA 观测得到的分子气体运动学来推导侧向星系中棒的位置角和长度。我们的方法利用了棒驱动气体流的几何特性：假设冷分子气体沉降到与棒正交取向的椭圆核环中，则核环的视向速度随棒的观测角度可预测地变化。仅使用观测到的核环速度和由多高斯展开（MGE）恒星质量模型得到的圆速度，我们构建了一组双对称棒流模型网格，覆盖一系列径向和横向速度，以约束棒的位置角。我们在一个玩具模型和一个孤立星系流体动力学模拟快照上验证了该方法，证明该技术能够可靠地区分三个观测角度区间：侧向（0° - 35°）、中间（35° - 65°）和端向（65° - 90°）。将该方法应用于六个具有盒状-花生状核球并拥有 ALMA CO 观测的 GECKOS 巡天星系，我们发现四个棒的取向为侧向，一个处于中间角度，一个为端向情形（IC 1711），后者证实了仅由恒星运动学得到的预测。推导出的核环尺寸和去投影棒长度与来自更正面观测的文献样本的测量结果大致一致。该方法为约束侧向星系中的棒性质提供了一种实用且计算廉价的手段，可补充完整的动力学建模方法。

title: A twist in the tail: GWLENS, a fast and accurate tool for wave-optics lensing of gravitational waves
summary: Gravitational-wave lensing in the wave-optics regime requires evaluating the Fresnel--Kirchhoff diffraction integral, whose integrand is highly oscillatory and must be evaluated numerically, as closed-form solutions exist only for a few lens models. We present a novel, efficient algorithm that splits the integration domain at a point beyond the region containing the lensed images. The bounded head region is integrated along the real axis with Gauss--Legendre quadrature, while the semi-infinite tail is rotated into the complex plane, where the integrand decays exponentially, and is evaluated with Gauss--Laguerre quadrature. Since the image region is never deformed, the method avoids the treatment of poles and branch cuts required by existing contour-deformation approaches. Our results agree with the exact point-mass solution to $10^{-13}$ and show good agreement with other methods. We present several examples for non-trivial lens models, showing potential for parameter estimation of realistic lenses. The method is particularly efficient when the amplification factor is needed for many source positions. In addition to transient broadband compact binary coalescence GW signals, we apply it to long-duration (continuous), quasi-monochromatic GW signals, for which the relative motion of source and lens makes the amplification factor time-dependent over the observation. The implementation is publicly available in the Python package GWLENS.

title: Map-Level Inference of Primordial Gravitational Waves from the CMB with Spherical Neural Networks
summary: We train a spherical graph convolutional network to infer the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$ directly from multifrequency cosmic microwave background (CMB) $B$-mode maps on the cut sky. We test the network on simulations of a generic ground-based experiment including lensed CMB, inhomogeneous noise, and stochastic Galactic dust and synchrotron emission. We compare the network with a multifrequency bandpower likelihood built from the same 20,000 simulations used to train it. Working directly on the maps, with no power-spectrum estimation or component separation, the network reduces the root-mean-square error on $r$ by a factor of 1.3 and gives well-calibrated 68% intervals 1.2 times narrower than the likelihood with the same prior. Saliency maps show that the network learns to favor the deepest regions of the sky and the cleanest frequency channels without being given the survey depth. Both approaches are tied to the foreground model they are built on: the network generalizes to some alternative foreground models without retraining, but not to a three-dimensional dust model with line-of-sight variations. The network can be extended to marginalize over foreground models by training on a broad family, making direct map-level neural inference a promising route to $r$ for future $B$-mode analyses.

title: The infrared arc around $α$ Crucis: a weak interaction with a structured interstellar medium
comment: Accepted for publication in Astrophysics and Space Science
summary: Infrared arc-shaped structures around early-type stars are commonly interpreted as stellar wind bow shocks, although their morphology may also be shaped by gas motions and density variations in the surrounding interstellar medium. We present a multiwavelength study of the infrared arc associated with the nearby $α$ Crucis system, comprising HD 108248 (B0.5 IV), HD 108249 (B1 V), and HD 108250 (B4 V). We combine WISE, Herschel, Planck, stellar astrometry, and eROSITA X-ray data to investigate the structure and its relation to the stellar components. The WISE W4 ridge extends over $\sim$0.65 pc and has a median PSF-corrected width of $\sim$0.037 pc. The HD 108248/HD 108249 pair lies $\sim$0.13 pc from the ridge, compared with $\sim$0.17 pc for HD 108250. Relative to the mean motion of the Lower Centaurus-Crux (LCC) subgroup of the Scorpius-Centaurus association, the close pair is consistent with LCC, whereas HD 108250 has a transverse peculiar velocity of only $\sim$1.8 km s$^{-1}$. Its motion lies within $\sim$23$^\circ$ of the geometrical symmetry axis of the infrared arc, but points in the opposite sense from the arc. Herschel maps show slightly higher median dust temperature ($ΔT_d\sim$0.8 K) and molecular-hydrogen column density ($ΔN_{\rm H2}\sim$7$\times$10$^{20}$ cm$^{-2}$) toward the W4-defined region than in the nearby background. On larger scales, Planck maps reveal a strongly structured microwave environment around the system. Both the HD 108248/HD 108249 pair and HD 108250 are detected by eROSITA, with the former approximately 60 times more luminous in X-rays. The combined morphology, kinematics, and dust properties do not support an unambiguous classical high-velocity bow-shock interpretation. Instead, the arc likely traces a weak interaction between the multiple stellar system and an inhomogeneous ambient medium.
